mapper.select: WITH recipe_matches AS ( SELECT rd.menu_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOCATE(#{query},im.ingredient_name_std)>0 THEN im.ingredient_name_std WHEN LOCATE(#{query},rd.ingredient_name_raw)>0 THEN rd.ingredient_name_raw ELSE im.ingredient_name_raw END ORDER BY rd.ingredient_seq SEPARATOR ', ') matched_ingredients FROM the_full_order.tb_recipe_detail rd LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master im ON im.ingredient_id=rd.ingredient_id WHERE LOCATE(#{query},im.ingredient_name_std)>0 OR LOCATE(#{query},im.ingredient_name_raw)>0 OR LOCATE(#{query},rd.ingredient_name_raw)>0 GROUP BY rd.menu_id ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'MENU' entity_type,m.menu_id entity_id,m.menu_name title,'메뉴' category, r.matched_ingredients FROM the_full_order.tb_menu_master m LEFT JOIN recipe_matches r ON r.menu_id=m.menu_id WHERE m.del_yn='N' AND (LOCATE(#{query},m.menu_name)>0 OR r.menu_id IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'INGREDIENT',ingredient_id,ingredient_name_std,'식재료',NULL FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND active_yn='Y' AND LOCATE(#{query},ingredient_name_std)>0 ) results ORDER BY CASE WHEN title=#{query} THEN 0 WHEN LOCATE(#{query},title)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CHAR_LENGTH(title),title,entity_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.menu_id,m.menu_name,m.food_type,m.meal_plan_type,m.calories_per_serving, COALESCE(u.usage_count,0) usage_count,COALESCE(u.recent_count,0) recent_count, COALESCE(f.favorite,0) favorite, COALESCE(f.favorite,0)*10+LEAST(COALESCE(u.usage_count,0),20)-COALESCE(u.recent_count,0)*5 score FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.account_id,d.menu_id,COUNT(*) usage_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ms.meal_date>=DATE_SUB(#{meal_date},INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND ms.meal_date<=#{meal_date} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) recent_count FROM the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=d.meal_service_id WHERE d.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.meal_date<=#{meal_date} AND ms.status!='CANCELED' GROUP BY d.account_id,d.menu_id ) u ON u.account_id=m.account_id AND u.menu_id=m.menu_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id,menu_id,MAX(CASE WHEN `like`=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) favorite FROM the_full_order.tb_like_menu WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND user_id=#{user_id} GROUP BY account_id,menu_id) f ON f.account_id=m.account_id AND f.menu_id=m.menu_id WHERE m.account_id=#{account_id} AND m.del_yn='N' AND m.meal_plan_type=#{meal_plan_type} ORDER BY score DESC,m.menu_name,m.menu_id LIMIT #{limit}
